services.desc: The saltwater fringes of Seattle Washington have fish biting any time of year. King Salmon and Coho Salmon are the most targeted sport fish in Puget Sound. Look below to see The Best Times For Salmon. When Salmon is closed we usually focus on bottom fishing for Flounder, Lingcod or Dungeness Crab. We may also fish catch and release for Salmon at times. Summer Salmon season OPENS JUNE 1st for Coho and July 17 for Kings THUR-SAT ONLY. (In-Season adjustments may happen for Kings, Quota likely to be caught by early August) While the chart below reflects the peak run times, it does not necessarily show when seasons are open.
